snippet.title: DRUNK Pilot Tries to Fly Plane
snippet.description:
CONTEXT: On April 27, 2017, the pilot of a Mooney
M20E aircraft contacted the Rocky Mountain Metropolitan Airport control tower in Broomfield, Colorado, seeking clearance to taxi and take off. However, due to the pilot's slurred speech and inability to properly communicate with the air traffic controller, the pilot was forced to taxi to a hangar and exit the aircraft in order to speak with airport officials. The airport officials called law enforcement and a member of the local sheriff's office responded to the call. Upon speaking with the pilot, he noted that the pilot's eyes were red and he was having trouble maintaining his balance. His speech was also slurred and there was the smell of alcohol on his breath. This prompted the arrest of the pilot, who took a breathalyzer once at the police station. The results of this test showed a BAC of .20 (in the US, the legal limit for operating an aircraft is .04, and the FAA mandates that pilots are not allowed to drink alcohol for at least eight hours prior to operating an aircraft.) The airport subsequently terminated its hangar lease with the owner of the aircraft, and it was soon after sold to a different and unrelated private owner. Please note that the footage in the video is of an unrelated aircraft because there is no footage of this incident. 

#airplane #aviation #pilot #drunk #shorts 

Footage: @PilotSpOB

snippet.title: KROATIENS KÜSTE: Fischer befreit gefangenen Delfin aus Netz!
snippet.description:
KROATIEN: Fischer rettet Delfin aus seinem Netz! Nur in Unterhose springt er ins offene Meer

Mitten auf dem Meer vor Kroatien kämpft ein Delfin ums Überleben: Der Meeressäuger hat sich in einem Fischernetz verfangen, jede Sekunde zählt. Ein Fischer erkennt die Gefahr und zögert nicht. Er springt ins Wasser, um das Tier aus der lebensbedrohlichen Lage zu befreien. Die Szene zeigt, wie schnell Fischernetze für Delfine zur Falle werden können – und wie wichtig entschlossenes Handeln ist, wenn Wildtiere in Not geraten.
